summary: Preserved candidate https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3414 at c5812a14220bf0d4ebe1cf98cd2c63b818c98aa8 and corrected the concrete counterexample independently reported by https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3433. Rust now validates bracketed endpoint contents as an actual IPv6 address before advertising /server_info.kv_events, so tcp://[not-ipv6]:5557 produces null like Python while valid bracketed IPv6 remains supported. The candidate's typed ServerArgs plumbing, additive field, allowlist, redaction, malformed-config handling, and secret-canary coverage remain intact.

tests.command: PATH=/job/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e4438b826eaf/cargo-target cargo test -p sglang-server bracketed_non_ipv6_host_is_not_advertisable --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml (before parser correction)
tests.what_was_measured: Independent failing-before reproduction on the exact candidate implementation: Rust returned Some(("[not-ipv6]", 5557)) where Python returns None.

tests.command: PATH=/job/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e4438b826eaf/cargo-target cargo test -p sglang-server api_server::common::tests --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
tests.what_was_measured: Passing-after Rust serializer contract: 5 focused tests cover the counterexample, valid IPv6, valid metadata, malformed/disabled configurations, page sizes, port bounds, allowlisting, and secret canaries.
Real Python /server_info route contract: 29 tests and 12 subtests passed, including endpoint, port, page-size, IPv6, field-preservation, and malformed configuration behavior.

tests.command: Python parse_advertisable_tcp reference probe for tcp://[not-ipv6]:5557, tcp://[2001:db8::5]:5557, and tcp://[::]:5557
tests.what_was_measured: Python returned None for the malformed bracketed hostname and accepted both concrete and wildcard bracketed IPv6 endpoints.
Forced a release native rebuild from /job/repo/rust using rustc 1.92.0 and imported the resulting extension from the private runtime cache.

tests.command: cd /job/repo/rust && PATH=/job/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo fmt --all -- --check && git diff --check
tests.what_was_measured: Rust formatting and patch whitespace validation.

gpu_evidence: No GPU execution was performed because this correction is CPU-only endpoint parsing and JSON metadata serialization. Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2 were left unchanged; model weights or architecture execution cannot add evidence for this parser defect.
remaining_limitations: The corrected Rust serializer and freshly rebuilt PyO3 native extension were exercised, but a live model-backed Axum server was not launched. The deterministic tiny-Llama fixture would add transport/engine smoke coverage but is not needed to establish this endpoint-parser correction.
KV-event publishing remains intentionally out of scope and was not exercised.
